Actually, is it? If the first order somehow didn't actually execute (but cash decreased...), then... cash decreased, so it executed. Buying 22 more → 44 shares max. Safe.

So place second order for 22 shares at ~222.75. Total $9,801. Then report the discrepancy and the shortfall of 16 shares.
